objective: Before the MR-write closure implementation, independently reconcile the exact accepted Doctor/Branch, Upload, and MR-list request/session/response/publication ownership contracts; bind physical owner/effect/cleanup/authority/response counterexamples and return READY or BLOCK without changing product code.

risk.rationale: The preflight is report-only and reversible, but it arbitrates accepted or candidate request-ledger, sealed-session, response, cleanup, nonce, publication, and authority semantics across diverged Python HTTP lineages. A wrong READY decision multiplies implementation and composition rework.

disallowed_actions: Create a dev-swarm manifest or launch the preflight while an accepted Upload or MR-list binding remains UNBOUND
Modify product, tests, source contracts, issue state, lifecycle state, or an existing review report
Treat a green candidate gate, worker handoff, draft report, or scoped predecessor review as an accepted binding
Implement the MR-write repair before the preflight report is committed and bound
Approve or integrate any product candidate from this report-only task
Replace an accepted predecessor contract with a weaker third model merely to obtain READY
Use helper-call counts, deleted helpers, constant labels, test-only stage jumps, or incomplete snapshots as physical ownership proof
Run Install, Dogfood, Close, Retrospect, Docker, or unrelated broad validation

non_goals: Repair Upload, MR-list, MR-write, Doctor, Branch, GC, Rust, file transport, packaging, or devcontainer code
Independently accept an implementation candidate or authorize product integration
Compose the Python HTTP product tree or resolve manager-owned product conflicts
Run unrestricted full-suite, Install, Dogfood, Close, or Retrospect work
Infer future accepted predecessor identities before their exact reports exist

invariants.statement: Preflight begins only after exact Upload and MR-list candidate parent, head, tree, patch digest, ACCEPT report commit, and report digest are bound with every finding disposed.
invariants.falsification_test: Leave one binding UNBOUND, substitute a REQUEST_CHANGES candidate, alter one product byte after review, or omit a report digest; readiness must remain blocked.

invariants.statement: Every request-reachable descriptor, buffer, record, permit, session, response, publication plan, postimage, and cleanup debt has one creating ledger, bounded lifetime, transfer, and terminal owner across the shared routes.
invariants.falsification_test: Omit each owner before allocation, restore a duplicate physical read, or leave one unreleased amount after a failing cleanup; the proposed oracle must detect the exact defect.

invariants.statement: Response preparation, publication planning, sealing, and the complete final authority fence precede the first effect; committed or durably recoverable effects cannot be replaced by a later selected response.
invariants.falsification_test: Move response preparation after escrow/publication, mutate each authority after its last observation, or inject postcommit cleanup failure; require no stale success, one exact response, and one terminal outcome.

invariants.statement: Request context, sealed snapshot, authority fence, prepared response, retryable cleanup, publication transaction, and error-origin behavior are reused or explicitly adapted; a surface-local fork requires a proven incompatibility.
invariants.falsification_test: Introduce a second ledger, snapshot reader, response selector, cleanup state, nonce transaction, or filesystem/transport classifier without an incompatibility proof; decision must be BLOCK.

invariants.statement: Every material F1-F7 claim has a live production entry point, independent observable oracle, exact boundary where applicable, and deliberate regression that fails for the intended reason.
invariants.falsification_test: Replace the regression with a deleted helper, constant label, helper counter, test-only skip, incomplete snapshot, or unrelated earlier limit; counterexample coverage must fail.

invariants.statement: The preflight changes only its report and cannot approve, repair, compose, or integrate product bytes.
invariants.falsification_test: Add any product, test, source-doc, issue, lifecycle, or existing report path to the diff; postflight write-set validation must reject the run.

validation.command: Recompute accepted Upload and MR-list parent/head/tree/patch/report identities and all finding dispositions before changing packet status to ready.
validation.purpose: Prevent preflight against a moving, rejected, or partially reviewed substitute.

validation.command: Trace Doctor, Branch, Upload, MR-list, and MR-write through the live HTTP dispatcher and map every owner, physical read, effect, response, cleanup, and terminal edge.
validation.purpose: Bind the shared primitive decision to production behavior rather than helper-only structure.

validation.command: For each material owner/effect/fence/response/cleanup/publication claim, specify or run one independent oracle and deliberate regression plus exact/minus-one/plus-one and 1x/3x/10x cases where applicable.
validation.purpose: Make the next implementation packet fail closed before coding when its proof plan is vacuous.

validation.command: git diff --name-only <launch-revision>..HEAD and git status --porcelain must contain only the declared preflight report and the worktree must be clean.
validation.purpose: Preserve reviewer independence and report-only scope.
